name: Ricardo Alvarez
bio:
Ricardo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. Growing up in Guadalajara, he initially pursued a degree in electrical engineering, but a chance encounter with a local racing team sparked an insatiable curiosity. He quickly immersed himself in the world of high-performance electronics, drawn to the intricate systems that powered the cars. After graduating, Ricardo honed his skills working for a smaller racing outfit, gaining invaluable experience in troubleshooting and optimizing electronic systems under pressure.

Ricardo is now a key member of the Arrow McLaren team, where he thrives on the fast-paced, competitive environment. He's known for his methodical approach, meticulously analyzing data to identify areas for improvement and pushing the boundaries of what's possible. While highly skilled technically, Ricardo also possesses a keen understanding of how electronic systems impact overall car performance, making him a valuable asset to the team. His pragmatic mindset allows him to make quick, effective decisions under the intense pressure of race day. 

Ricardo's lone wolf nature means he prefers to work independently, diving deep into data and rarely collaborating unless absolutely needed. He's known to work long hours and often keeps to himself, but his contributions are undeniably valuable to the team's success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Ricardo is a lean man with sharp features and an intense gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with circuit diagrams and technical notes.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Refuses to drink coffee, preferring yerba mate instead.
